About us

The Cambridge University Algorithmic Trading Society (CUATS) is the first student society in Cambridge to promote the understanding of algorithms and their applications in financial trading. CUATS aims to provide interdisciplinary education on algorithm development and the basics of financial investment strategies.

1750 Members

50+ Yearly Events

10 Years Active

150 Hours of Coding Sessions

What We Do

Speaker Series

We host outstanding, accomplished individuals across academia and industry in a series of talks and seminars held throughout the academic year. Academics discuss their research in quant finance, and industry experts share their experiences in real-life automated trading.

Coding Sessions

Our weekly Sunday coding sessions introduce basic to more advanced algorithmic trading strategies that profitably capture anomalies in the market based on sound mathematical concepts and statistical analysis techniques.  During the sessions, you learn how to implement systematic trading ideas in code.

These are hands-on, in-person sessions for Cambridge students.

Industry-Sponsored Workshops

Our workshop events with our sponsoring companies and top industry employers enable members to participate in trading simulations, brain teasers, market making games, and to meet quant traders and recruitment leads.

Fireside Chat Series

To complement our Speaker Series, we initiated the Fireside Chat Series to highlight the experiences of current students and recent graduates who have either completed internships or are working in the quant finance industry. We organise a roundtable discussion to coincide with the recruitment season and ask our colleagues questions about the interview process, first assignments on the job, and generally what it’s like to work at the firm they interned or are employed at.

Conference

CUATS is hosting its sixth annual Quant Conference on 26 February 2027 bringing together leading experts in the quant fields of alpha generation, portfolio optimisation, execution, and risk management.  The agendas of this year’s conference and previous years’ conferences, including full bio details of the speakers, the titles and abstracts of their talks, may be viewed by clicking the dropdown links above.

Gala

The sixth annual CUATS Gala will be held on 18 June 2027. This flagship event of the society, held in the Cambridge Union, is a formal black-tie event where members of the society are paired with industry sponsors for dinner, providing an exceptional opportunity for networking and career advancement.

Challenge: Coding Competition

Our annual coding competition designed to showcase Cambridge University talent in developing the best trading algorithms using a combination of novel ideas, alternative datasets, and clever execution approaches. The coding competition runs for two months over winter break from the beginning of November to the start of Lent term in January with team presentations and winners announced in February after backtesting and out-of-sample, live testing of submissions.

Awards include Certificates and CUATS merchandise!

Insight Days

We launched an initiative to arrange in-person site visits to some of the leading quant firms in London and other cities, providing a real-life glimpse into the life of a quant trader, quant researcher, and quant developer and strengthening the society’s connections to its sponsoring companies.   

Alex Example

We organise a social gathering of members to watch the Fed Chair’s press conferences and to live trade around the eight FOMC interest rate announcements that occur per year, explain the rationale behind the executed trades, and further develop our abilities to codify opportunistic trading strategies. These mini-competitions contrast with the annual CUATS Challenge – Coding Competition which is longer in duration and focuses on lower frequency algorithmic trading strategies which is also our main focus in the Coding Sessions.
